crosswalk.original_criterion: P11-IMP-040/041: Canonical definitions must connect to operational units and categories in real deployment/first-setup path.
crosswalk.root_cause: FirstSetupBootstrapHandler never preloads operational units or categories. TaxonomyV3Store.UnitDefinitions (51 units) is never read by production services. ProductManagementReadService reads _db.Units and _db.Categories, which remain empty on fresh installation.
crosswalk.repair_path: Implement transactional bootstrap preload in FirstSetupBootstrapHandler and idempotent catalog reference loader to populate operational units and operational reference categories from TaxonomyV3Store without duplicate ID collisions.
crosswalk.positive_oracle: Fresh setup populates operational unit and category pickers with canonical definitions. Repeat execution preserves existing IDs/values without duplicates.
crosswalk.negative_oracle: Corrupted or conflicting incoming data aborts atomically without partial mutation.
crosswalk.remaining_gap: Pending code integration and verification in Task T3/T6.

crosswalk.original_criterion: P11-IMP-041 Gate D: Operational units must enforce physical dimension compatibility and conversion policies.
crosswalk.root_cause: ConfigureProductUnitsHandler and SaveProductHandler only validate positive factors and integer factors for Container/Serialized tracking. They omit dimension checks, fixed conversion checks (1 FT = 0.3048 M, 1 DOZ = 12 PCS), Gate D gated stock unit checks, and required explicit factors for packaging units.
crosswalk.repair_path: Implement shared ProductUnitValidator enforcing: (1) dimension compatibility against base unit, (2) exact fixed conversion factors where policy is FIXED/FIXED_TO_*, (3) rejection of gated mass/volume/area units for stock unless authorized, (4) explicit positive factors for packaging units (BOX/COIL/PAIR/SET), (5) preservation of commercial history locks.
crosswalk.positive_oracle: Valid units (e.g. PCS base with DOZ factor 12, or M base with FT factor 0.3048, or BOX with custom product factor 50) save successfully.
crosswalk.negative_oracle: Cross-dimension mappings (FT -> PCS), wrong fixed ratios (FT -> M with factor 2.0), or gated units (KG with Count base) fail closed with catalog.invalid_unit_conversion or catalog.dimension_mismatch.
crosswalk.remaining_gap: Pending code integration and verification in Task T3/T6.

crosswalk.original_criterion: P11-IMP-040: Authoritative product-to-canonical-leaf relationship in persistence models, EF configurations, and editor contracts.
crosswalk.root_cause: Product entity in CatalogModels.cs contains CategoryId but lacks ClassRef. EF ProductConfiguration lacks FK mapping to catalog_v3.product_classes. Product edit viewmodel infers department from category name.
crosswalk.repair_path: Add ClassRef property to Product and ProductCatalogInput; configure EF Core ProductConfiguration with optional foreign key to catalog_v3.product_classes(class_ref); support legacy records while validating new assignments server-side against canonical leaves.
crosswalk.positive_oracle: Saved product stores authoritative ClassRef; navigation to canonical leaf retrieves product.
crosswalk.negative_oracle: Invalid or deprecated navigation-only class reference is rejected; deleting a referenced class in database is prevented by FK protection.
crosswalk.remaining_gap: Pending code integration and verification in Task T3/T6.

crosswalk.original_criterion: P11-IMP-040: Structured taxonomy filtering must not widen leaf selection to an entire department and division selection must expand to descendant hierarchy.
crosswalk.root_cause: ProductManagementViewModel.ApplyFilters maps leaf class to its department name and adds it to matchingTaxonomyCategories, causing all products in that department to match. Division selection lacks hierarchy descendant expansion.
crosswalk.repair_path: Separate structured taxonomy filtering from free-text search. A leaf node matches exact ClassRef/CanonicalClassRef; a department node matches all classes in that department; a division node matches all descendant departments and classes. Resolve redirects consistently.
crosswalk.positive_oracle: Selecting leaf class A01-01 displays only products bound to A01-01, excluding siblings in A01. Selecting division A displays all products in all A departments.
crosswalk.negative_oracle: Unrelated products with names or codes that happen to contain substring 'A01' are not leaked into leaf filter results.
crosswalk.remaining_gap: Pending code integration and verification in Task T4/T6.

crosswalk.original_criterion: P11-IMP-040: Dry-run preview must be strictly non-mutating (zero writes, zero DDL execution) on both existing and missing schema targets.
crosswalk.root_cause: TaxonomyV3Importer.ExecuteDryRunAsync invokes EnsureSchemaAsync before capturing WAL/LSN, creating schema and tables on fresh targets during preview.
crosswalk.repair_path: Check for schema existence non-destructively in dry-run without executing DDL. If schema/tables do not exist, report missing prerequisite status in dry-run report without executing CREATE TABLE/SCHEMA.
crosswalk.positive_oracle: Dry-run against clean database performs zero writes (WAL/LSN unchanged, zero DDL executions).
crosswalk.negative_oracle: Target database has zero new tables or schema modifications after dry-run.
crosswalk.remaining_gap: Pending code integration and verification in Task T3/T6.

crosswalk.original_criterion: P11-IMP-040: Safety claims, manifest hash scope, and preview/apply parity must reflect true calculated target diffs.
crosswalk.root_cause: TaxonomyV3Importer hardcodes IsSafeToApply = true, collisions_detected = 0, planned_operations = store counts. ComputeStoreHash omits class status, type, role, canonical ref, rule, redirect fields, and unit definitions/policies.
crosswalk.repair_path: Compute actual target diff by querying existing catalog_v3 tables; calculate real insert/update/unchanged/conflict counts; include all semantic fields, redirects, unit definitions, and policies in manifest SHA256 computation.
crosswalk.positive_oracle: Diff accurately reports actual insert counts on fresh database, and 0 inserts / all unchanged on repeated seed. Manifest hash changes if any semantic field changes.
crosswalk.negative_oracle: Detects schema drift or conflicting modifications, setting IsSafeToApply to false and reporting concrete violations.
crosswalk.remaining_gap: Pending code integration and verification in Task T3/T6.

crosswalk.original_criterion: P11-IMP-040: Operational alias search must resolve canonical class and department aliases correctly, supporting bilingual search (English/Urdu).
crosswalk.root_cause: ProductManagementReadService treats all search aliases as department references and uses incorrect hardcoded department mappings (B01 fan, B04 iron). 'pankha' targeting Class B05-01 is never matched.
crosswalk.repair_path: Inspect TargetType ('CLASS' vs 'DEPARTMENT') on matched search alias. If TargetType == 'CLASS', query products by authoritative ClassRef / CanonicalClassRef (e.g. B05-01 for pankha/fan). Eliminate erroneous B01/B04 fallbacks.
crosswalk.positive_oracle: Searching 'pankha' or 'fan' returns ceiling fans classified under B05-01 even when the Urdu word 'pankha' is not present in the product's English name.
crosswalk.negative_oracle: B01 (lamps) and B04 (LED strips) products are not erroneously returned when searching for fans.
crosswalk.remaining_gap: Pending code integration and verification in Task T4/T6.

crosswalk.original_criterion: Universal evidence rule: Tests must assert production migrations and referential constraints without circular test-setup DDL modifications.
crosswalk.root_cause: CatalogV3SeedLifecyclePostgresTests executes 'ALTER TABLE catalog.products ADD COLUMN class_ref...' inside the test setup, masking the absence of production migration and EF configuration.
crosswalk.repair_path: Remove test-created ALTER TABLE commands. Test real production schema migration, proving that catalog.products naturally possesses class_ref column and foreign key constraint to catalog_v3.product_classes.
crosswalk.positive_oracle: Integration test runs against clean, untouched EF Core production migration, verifying referential integrity and foreign key rejection natively.
crosswalk.negative_oracle: Attempting to insert a product with an invalid class_ref or deleting an actively referenced class_ref fails with foreign key violation (SQLSTATE 23503) without test-time schema modification.
crosswalk.remaining_gap: Pending code integration and verification in Task T5/T6.
